name: Revisit Session Recording
author: Revisit

sections.description:
Revisit Session Recording allows you to record and replay user sessions on your WordPress website. Watch exactly how visitors interact with your site, identify usability issues, and make data-driven decisions to improve the user experience.

Why Session Recording?

Understanding your users is crucial for building a successful website. With Revisit, you can:

  • See Through Your Users’ Eyes – Watch real sessions to understand how people actually use your site
  • Find and Fix UX Issues – Identify where users get confused, stuck, or frustrated
  • Optimize Conversions – Improve checkout flows, forms, and key conversion paths
  • Debug Faster – Replay sessions to understand bug reports and reproduce issues
  • Validate Changes – See how users respond to new features and designs

Key Features

  • Effortless Setup – Connect your Revisit account and start recording in under 2 minutes
  • Lightweight Script – Async loading with minimal impact on page performance
  • Privacy First – Automatic masking of sensitive data, GDPR compliant
  • Project Selection – Easily switch between multiple Revisit projects
  • One-Click Toggle – Enable or disable recording instantly from WordPress admin
  • Secure Authentication – Token-based auth keeps your credentials safe

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Login with your Revisit account
  3. Select the project for this WordPress site
  4. Sessions are automatically recorded and synced to your Revisit dashboard

That’s it! No code changes needed. View recorded sessions at app.revisit.pro.

Use Cases

  • E-commerce – Optimize product pages and checkout flows
  • SaaS Landing Pages – Improve signup conversions
  • Blogs & Content Sites – Understand reader engagement
  • Membership Sites – Enhance user onboarding
  • Lead Generation – Optimize forms and CTAs

About Revisit

Revisit is a modern session recording and analytics platform designed for teams who care about user experience. Learn more at revisit.pro.

Privacy

This plugin connects to the Revisit service (revisit.pro) to provide session recording functionality. When using this plugin:

Data sent to Revisit:
* Your login credentials are sent to Revisit servers for authentication (not stored by the plugin)
* Your site’s frontend visitors’ session data is recorded and sent to Revisit servers

Data stored locally:
* Authentication tokens (encrypted, stored in WordPress database)
* Selected project configuration
* User email (for display purposes only)

Third-party service:
* Service: Revisit (revisit.pro)
* Privacy Policy: https://revisit.pro/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://revisit.pro/terms

The plugin requires an active internet connection to function. Recorded session data is processed and stored by Revisit in accordance with their privacy policy.

For GDPR compliance, you should inform your site visitors about session recording in your privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Revisit Session Recording”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Navigate to Revisit in your admin sidebar
  5. Login with your Revisit account and select a project

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Revisit in your admin menu to configure

First Time Setup

  1. Click Revisit in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Enter your Revisit email and password
  3. If you have MFA enabled, enter your authenticator code
  4. Select the project you want to use for this site
  5. Recording starts automatically!

Don’t have a Revisit account? Sign up free
sections.faq:
Do I need a Revisit account?

Yes, you need a Revisit account to use this plugin. You can create a free account in seconds.

Does this slow down my website?

No. The recording script loads asynchronously and is optimized for performance. It typically adds less than 50ms to page load time.

What exactly is recorded?

Revisit records user interactions including:
– Mouse movements and clicks
– Scrolling behavior
– Form interactions (with sensitive fields automatically masked)
– Page navigation
– Console errors and network issues

Is recorded data secure?

Absolutely. All data is:
– Transmitted over HTTPS with TLS 1.3
– Stored in encrypted databases
– Processed in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations
– Automatically purged based on your retention settings

Can I exclude certain pages from recording?

Yes! You can configure recording rules in your Revisit dashboard, including:
– Exclude specific URLs or URL patterns
– Exclude logged-in users
– Record only specific pages
– Set custom sampling rates

How do I view recorded sessions?

Login to your Revisit dashboard at app.revisit.pro to view, search, and analyze recorded sessions.

Can I use this with WooCommerce?

Yes! Revisit works great with WooCommerce. See how customers interact with your products and optimize your checkout flow.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes, Revisit is compatible with all major page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and Gutenberg.

Can I use multiple projects?

Yes, you can switch between projects anytime from the plugin settings. This is useful if you manage multiple sites or want to separate staging from production data.

What if I have MFA enabled on my Revisit account?

The plugin fully supports Multi-Factor Authentication. After entering your password, you’ll be prompted for your authenticator code.
